text:
PokémonXP & 2026 Pokémon World Championships | Official Trailer
PokémonXP is the first-ever official Pokémon fan convention and will feature exciting panels with the latest scoop on Pokémon news and backstories about shaping the Pokémon world.

The 2026 Pokémon World Championships are the pinnacle of competitive Pokémon where top Trainers from around the globe are gathering to compete in VGC, TCG, GO, and UNITE - all for the chance at being crowned a World Champion.

Tune in live on Official Pokémon YouTube and Twitch channels from August 28 to 30 to witness a historic Pokémon weekend!

To learn more, visit Pokemon.com/PXP-Broadcast or Pokemon.com/Worlds-Broadcast

Champions | 2026 Pokémon World Championships | Official Soundtrack
The 2026 Season of the Pokémon Championship Series draws to an
epic conclusion, as the top Trainers from around the globe gather in
San Franscisco for the 2026 Pokémon World Championships.

Get immersed in the energy of the biggest competitive Pokémon
event to-date. “Champions” is a powerful anthem, capturing our
collective dreams of becoming Pokémon Champions.

By Pokémon, Loren Allred
